mechanism: Connect the immutable cache-indexed R4 expert table to the resident device-router forward path, fuse router selection through guarded routed/shared expert execution and residual mutation on table hits, and fail closed through a typed cold-miss replay.

admission.unsupported_selected_layout: GPU validation sets the execution-position miss bit and suppresses every subsequent write.
admission.unsupported_shared_layout: No table graph is encoded; router plus device trace commits and the qualified host-known wave runs.

command_buffer: routed gate and up indirect matvecs
score-aligned AXPY in ascending expert-ID execution order
shared gate/up/SiLU/down through a one-entry immutable lease
hit_graph.expert_trace: Selected IDs are copied device-to-device per sparse layer and reconstructed once after the token graph; weights are never downloaded on hits.
hit_graph.resource_lifetime: Every indirectly referenced Metal buffer is cloned into an immutable table lease and declared with useResources before submission.

miss_graph.fallback: Read the persisted device IDs and weights, admit the selected triplets, and replay through the previously qualified expert wave.

synchronization_evidence.interpretation: A warm table hit merges the router commit and the expert-wave commit. This is a synchronization result, not a flagship latency claim.

profiler_accounting.routed_active_bytes: Exact R4 gate/up/down buffer extents multiplied by the device-selected expert count.
profiler_accounting.routed_representation_touches: Every table-hit routed projection is recorded as R4.
operations: all routed and shared PQ matvec contractions and reduction adds

qualified: The production resident path can consume device-selected R4 expert IDs and weights without a layer-critical selection download.
A warm R4 table hit executes router selection through the residual mutation in one command buffer and one wait per sparse layer.
Cold and heterogeneous selections fail closed without mutating expert scratch or the residual and replay through the qualified path.
Exact discrete decisions and complete-token Numeric Parity V2.1 hold over four non-vacuous sparse selection patterns.
The profiler retains a complete active-byte, representation, matvec, and source-modelled operation partition for table hits.
not_qualified: The sealed Math-Preserve artifact has not been run under this mechanism.
R0 bits7 and native-bf16 expert triplets do not execute indirectly and fall back.
The immutable descriptor table is rebuilt and uploaded per sparse layer per token; persistent per-layer tables are not implemented.
No 2K, 8K, 32K, TTFT, TPS, thermal, swap, or flagship latency promotion is claimed.
The sealed profiling and autotune lane remains gated by MOP receipts plus four clear one-minute observations.
qualification.next_boundary: Persist generation-keyed expert tables across tokens, add indirect R0 and native-bf16 projection kernels or a heterogeneous dispatch table, then measure the complete flagship token graph after the MOP clearance gate.
